issues.where: the standing shaggy animal centered at the cave mouth, frames 8031–8304
issues.what: the camera clears the nearer bodies but the standing animal holds nearly the same head and body silhouette through most of the approach; it reads as another placed model rather than a living subject
issues.fix: give it a planted weight shift, a small head turn and an independently timed breath or coat response before the camera settles

issues.where: the wind streaks issuing from the central and neighboring spires, frames 7718–7855
issues.what: the bright forked ribbons retain almost the same outline and attachment points during the long hold, making the strongest cue for moving air read as fixed geometry
issues.fix: keep the wind direction but shed irregular wisps from each tip, letting them stretch, separate and dissipate at different rates

issues.where: the long pale streamer on the right and the shorter bands beneath it, frames 7411–7498
issues.what: the truck reveals real depth at the cliff edge but the streamers keep long parallel edges and move as stiff sheets rather than bending and breaking in the air
issues.fix: vary thickness and curl along the bands, breaking their trailing ends into wisps that move independently of the camera

issues.where: the cave floor and inner left wall on the lightning peaks at frames 8091 and 8094
issues.what: the off-cave flash lifts a broad area of the interior at once, with little distinction between surfaces exposed to the opening and those behind the rock and animals
issues.fix: shape the flash from the cave mouth with distance falloff and occlusion, catching exposed ice edges while keeping sheltered areas darker
